# Find PNAS Editor

> Article-level credits and annual editor counts for PNAS works in the OpenAlex topic “Tropical and Extratropical Cyclones Research” (T11483), from 2020 onward.

## Data

- [Complete dataset (JSON)](./data.json) — Fetch this static file with a single GET. It contains all listed articles and the annual counts for each person.
- [Human-readable tables](./index.html) — The article list and annual counts are in the HTML.

## Reading the records

- `articles` contains one record per DOI. Use `role` and `credited_name` to identify the person's credit. Cite `credit_source_url`, which links to the PNAS article HTML.
- `editor` means the person edited the paper. `contributor` means PNAS credited them as its contributing member. `commentary` identifies the commentary author. A separately named accepting editorial board member has their own field.
- `people[].annual_counts` gives integer `edited` and `contributed` counts by publication year. Commentary is excluded from these two counts. The summary groups name variants under `canonical_name` from the article records.
- `people[].nas_membership` gives the membership type, election year, and official U.S. National Academy of Sciences profile URL for confirmed members, including international members. A null value means no profile was confirmed.
- `listed_count` counts the records in this file. `openalex_count` and `openalex_count_checked_at` describe the most recent successful OpenAlex count check. A higher OpenAlex count means additional works may need to be added.
